methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Collects device details such as MAC addresses, firmware version, etc. (Deprecated API, use newer methods)

methods.name: getDownloadedFirmwareInfo
methods.description: Returns information about firmware downloads, including current, downloaded versions, and location.

methods.name: getFirmwareDownloadPercent
methods.description: Returns the current firmware download percentage.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateInfo
methods.description: Checks the firmware update information and triggers an event when info is received.

methods.name: getFirmwareUpdateState
methods.description: Checks the current state of a firmware update process.

methods.name: getLastFirmwareFailureReason
methods.description: Retrieves the last firmware failure reason.

methods.name: getLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the last wakeup keycode.

methods.name: getMacAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves various MAC addresses of the device.

methods.name: getMfgSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the manufacturing serial number of the device.

methods.name: getNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Returns whether network standby mode is supported.

methods.name: getPlatformConfiguration
methods.description: Returns supported features and device info.

methods.name: getPowerState
methods.description: Returns the current power state of the device.

methods.name: getPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Returns the device power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: getSerialNumber
methods.description: Returns the device serial number.

methods.name: getSystemVersions
methods.description: Returns system version details.

methods.name: getFriendlyName
methods.description: Returns the device's friendly name.

methods.name: getTerritory
methods.description: Retrieves system territory and region.

methods.name: getTimeZones
methods.description: Retrieves available timezone information.

methods.name: getTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Get the configured timezone and accuracy.

methods.name: getWakeupReason
methods.description: Returns the reason for device waking from deep sleep.

methods.name: isOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Checks if telemetry opt-out is enabled.

methods.name: reboot
methods.description: Requests a device reboot, with optional reboot reason.

methods.name: requestSystemUptime
methods.description: Returns device uptime in seconds.

methods.name: setDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Sets deep sleep timeout period.

methods.name: setFirmwareAutoReboot
methods.description: Enables or disables auto reboot after firmware updates.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets system mode (NORMAL, EAS, WAREHOUSE) for a specific duration.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Enables or disables network standby mode (deprecated in favor of setWakeupSrcConfiguration).

methods.name: setOptOutTelemetry
methods.description: Sets telemetry opt-out status.

methods.name: setPowerState
methods.description: Sets the device power state (e.g., ON, STANDBY).

methods.name: setFriendlyName
methods.description: Sets the device friendly name.

methods.name: setBootLoaderSplashScreen
methods.description: Configures bootloader splash screen from specified file path.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Returns the build type of the flashed firmware image.

methods.name: setTerritory
methods.description: Sets device territory and region.

methods.name: setTimeZoneDST
methods.description: Sets system timezone and triggers change event.

methods.name: updateFirmware
methods.description: Initiates a firmware update process.

methods.name: uploadLogsAsync
methods.description: Starts background logs upload.

methods.name: abortLogUpload
methods.description: Stops logs upload.
